added_failures_note: manifest.md:16-17 records completed base and head suites. Both have only tests/test_forward_operator_axes.py::test_tensor_product_grid_class_margin_is_read_on_the_spline failing; baseline-suite.log ends 178 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1 and after-suite-final.log ends 183 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1, so head failure ids minus base failure ids is empty.
assertion_analysis: tests/test_shared_primitives.py:17-18: the independent literal linspace and step fail if endpoint reconstruction or step changes; negative-control.log confirms the float32 axis assertion reddens under spacing differencing.
tests/test_shared_primitives.py:22-25: the two raises fail if ragged axes or undersized axes are admitted.

tests/test_shared_primitives.py:33-39: literal JSON bytes fail on changed ordering, indentation, newline or compact separators; directory listing fails on a left-behind temporary; the TypeError and unchanged bytes fail on permissive or destructive serialization.
tests/test_shared_primitives.py:45-49: literal canonical bytes and whitespace refusal fail if those contracts change; the JSON roundtrip is a weaker value check but not used as the sole guard.
tests/test_shared_primitives.py:57-58: the literal compact JSON digest fails if stable_digest changes the bytes it hashes; the expectation is independent of the function under test.
No added assertion compares an observed value to an expected value computed by the same production helper; the remaining gaps are missing assertions for caller delegation and fsync.

findings.text: non-blocking: the atomic-writer test checks bytes, cleanup and failed serialization, but removing os.fsync or changing os.replace to a direct write in nova/io/json.py:39-47 leaves its assertions green; the writer’s durability and atomic replacement contract has no regression guard.

non-blocking: the axis tests invoke uniform_axis directly and do not assert that the four production sites continue to delegate to it; restoring a private caller check can recreate the duplication while these tests remain green, so the zero-copy census is a one-time measurement.
